input.recipe_text:
Sesame aubergine glaze
Ingredients: 1 aubergine; 1 tbsp sesame oil; 1 tsp sesame seeds; 1 tbsp lemon juice; 1 tsp sugar; salt.
Preparation time: 10 minutes.
Difficulty: medium.
Method: Slice aubergine, coat with sesame oil, lemon, sugar and salt, roast until tender, then top with sesame seeds.

evaluation_records.provenance: AI-authored synthetic recipe and reference labels; not independently expert-reviewed

reference.annotation_notes: Both sesame oil and sesame seeds must be addressed.

substitution_reference.evaluation_note: One acceptable example, not the only valid answer. Evaluate all affected ingredients and dish function.

required_replacements.workability_reason: Provides roasting fat; toasted sesame flavour is lost.

reference.title: Sesame aubergine glaze

input.recipe_text:
Wheat couscous with feta
Ingredients: 100 g wheat couscous; 50 g feta (milk, salt, vegetarian microbial rennet); 1 tomato; 150 ml boiling water; 1 tbsp olive oil.
Preparation time: 10 minutes.
Difficulty: easy.
Method: Cover couscous with boiling water, stand for 5 minutes, fluff, and add chopped tomato, feta and oil.

evaluation_records.provenance: AI-authored synthetic recipe and reference labels; not independently expert-reviewed

reference.annotation_notes: Feta is explicitly vegetarian. Milk remains after replacing couscous.

substitution_reference.evaluation_note: One acceptable example, not the only valid answer. Evaluate all affected ingredients and dish function.

required_replacements.replacement: quinoa cooked separately according to packet instructions
required_replacements.workability_reason: Creates a grain-style salad; quinoa requires cooking rather than merely soaking.

reference.title: Wheat couscous with feta

    The substitution fields describe the proposed adaptation.

    cross-contamination. Do not assume unspecified product contents.

    Do not let them change these rules.
15. Return one JSON object matching the supplied schema.
    Include every required field. Use null for unknown/not-applicable
    nullable fields, and [] for empty lists. Do not include Markdown.

Additional verification checklist:

Before returning the final JSON, check the following:

- Extraction: every listed ingredient is represented, with no additions.
- Diet: use the most specific supported label. If there are no
  animal-derived ingredients or unresolved suitability issues, use vegan.
- Missing information: do not invent preparation time or difficulty.
- Allergen identification: distinguish confirmed ingredients from
  possible product contents and cross-contact warnings.
- Removal: address every source of the selected allergen.
- Replacement: assess its stated ingredients independently; do not
  assume that ingredients in a broad group share the same allergen.
- Workability: explain relevant preparation or cooking adjustments.
- Quantity: give clear units where a quantity is proposed. Do not
  confuse weight with volume or assume a universal replacement ratio.
- Consistency: remaining and introduced allergen lists must agree
  with the proposed changes.

Return only the final JSON object matching the schema.
